title: Connect the two
concept: git remote add origin, git remote -v

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: We need to connect your local folder to GitHub. We'll add a 'remote' server named 'origin'.

hints: Your local repo needs to know where the online copy lives.
A remote is a link to another copy of your repo, usually on GitHub.
Answer the question about `git remote add origin <url>`.

questions.explanation: git remote -v shows the URL of the remote.

recap: git remote add origin <url> connects your local git repo to GitHub.
